sourceOnlyStories.originalTitle: What we know about stabbing on Flydubai flight to Israel
sourceOnlyStories.snippet: A pilot has been arrested and is being questioned after another pilot was stabbed, officials say.
sourceOnlyStories.fullContent:
This video can not be played

A flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv was diverted to Saudi Arabia on Wednesday after one pilot stabbed the other and "apparently tried to crash the plane", Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has said.

The pilot was arrested and is being questioned by Saudi authorities, Netanyahu added.

The stabbed pilot, identified as Indian national Capt Smit Machchhar, was taken to hospital after the flight landed and later called a "hero" by the Israeli prime minister.

Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz has called the incident an "attempted jihadist terror attack". The BBC is yet to receive official statements from police, emergency services, or investigators regarding any motive.

Here's what we know.

Flydubai's flight FZ1073 took off from Dubai International Airport in the United Arab Emirates at 03:05 GMT (07:05 local time) en route to Ben-Gurion Airport in Israel.

The flight was carrying at least 150 people, with Netanyahu saying "almost all" passengers were Israeli.

Data from flight tracking website Flightrader24 shows a rapid descent for the plane over Saudi Arabia around two and a half hours after take-off, dropping more than 17,000 feet (over 5,000m) in less than two minutes at around 05:21.

Minutes later, the plane signalled an emergency code - squawk 7700 - before switching it to a squawk 7500 code reporting a hijacking.

At 05:40, the plane - which had briefly entered Jordanian airspace - looped back into Saudi Arabia, where it later started its manual descent for landing.

Less than an hour later, the plane returned to squawk 7700.

Initial local media reports cited Israeli officials as saying a fight had broken out between two pilots.

But, speaking on Wednesday following the incident, Netanyahu confirmed later reports that one pilot had stabbed the other before "apparently trying to crash" the plane.

He said an Israeli passenger told him "the plane went into a spin and began to descend" before the passenger and a crew member broke into the cockpit and overpowered the "pilot who had carried out the stabbing".

The plane was diverted to Tabuk Airport in northwestern Saudi Arabia and touched down at 06:58, according to location data.

The stabbed pilot, who is in a stable condition according to the Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia, was later identified as Indian national Capt Smit Machchhar.

Paying tribute to Machchhar, Netanyahu hailed him as a "true hero" and said "he saved the lives of 174 people, including Israeli citizens and other nationals".

Passenger Yaniv Hayun, who was later greeted and described as a hero by Netanyahu, said in a video released by the prime minister's office that he and others were trying to open the cockpit door, but the stabbed pilot was very close to it.

Before the pilot collapsed, the injured man managed to open the door, Hayun said.

He said that inside, the attacker was "trying to destroy the instruments in order to disable the plane".

Hayun then described putting the attacker in a chokehold and pulling him outside of the cockpit before other passengers helped to pin him down.

He added that he "pulled the controls" of the plane, explaining to Netanyahu that he watches Canadian documentary series Air Crash Investigation. "The plane started to level out, a bit more, and then [another] pilot told me he was taking control from there."

Zvika Meness, another passenger, told Israeli public broadcaster Kan News that he and other passengers tied the attacker up "with his own zip ties and with the multimedia headphones".

"There are children and families here who have been through a very severe, highly traumatic event," he added.

Yasmin Abukasis told Reuters that her daughter who was on the flight said a man holding a knife had forced one of the pilots onto the floor, with blood everywhere.

"The plane start to lose control. So all the people, they scream, they think they are going," Abukasis told AP news agency.

Speaking from Ben Gurion Airport, she said her daughter phoned her to say she heard screaming as a pilot called for help, adding that two other pilots took control of the plane as other passengers ran towards a man who had a knife.

Almog Itali, who was also on board the flight, told media that one of the pilots who landed the aircraft was British. The other pilot was European, Itali said, although he did not provide a specific nationality.

One female passenger described the "very stressful" moment people realised the plane was descending. "We understood the pilots lost control," she told Israeli newspaper Israel Hayom.

"There are people here with shirts covered in blood," she said, adding: "Now we are fine and want to return home."

Shortly after the incident, the Israeli and Saudi Arabian air forces dispatched fighter jets, while Netanyahu held urgent consultations.

Speaking later on Wednesday, Netanyahu called the situation a "a very serious security incident".

He added Israeli security forces are "maintaining close contact with the relevant authorities to ensure the continued safety of the passengers".

"I salute these heroes who demonstrated extraordinary resourcefulness and courage," he added. "They saved many lives and prevented a major disaster."

Flydubai meanwhile said "an altercation occurred in the flight deck" and the flight was "successfully secured by on-duty Flydubai crew travelling on the flight, who diverted and landed the aircraft safely at Tabuk airport".

The airline said two replacement aircraft were sent to Tabuk to relieve the passengers and crew, and the incident had no impact on other scheduled operations.

The repatriation flight carrying passengers left Tabuk at 17:40 local time (14:40 GMT) and arrived in Tel Aviv at around 18:40 local time (15:40 GMT).

The spokesperson added: "Our immediate priority is to ensure the ongoing safety, health, and wellbeing of all passengers and crew members involved in this incident and support the official investigation."

后续负责调查事件动机与责任的警方、急救部门和调查机构
consensus: 航班从迪拜起飞，途中在沙特上空出现异常下降并发出紧急及劫机代码，随后改降沙特塔布克机场。
一名飞行员受刀伤并被送医，报道援引印度使馆称其伤势稳定；另一名飞行员被沙特当局逮捕并接受询问。
Flydubai确认驾驶舱发生冲突，称当班机组及相关人员最终使飞机安全降落，航空公司随后安排乘客返程。
多名乘客或家属描述了驾驶舱附近的尖叫、失控下降、人员试图进入驾驶舱及制服持刀者等情况。
航班最终安全着陆，乘客被转运回特拉维夫；航空公司称事件未影响其他既定航班运行。
disagreements: 事件最初被部分当地媒体和以色列官员描述为飞行员之间的打斗，之后内塔尼亚胡称一名飞行员刺伤另一名飞行员并“似乎试图让飞机坠毁”；报道未提供独立调查结论来解决这一叙事差异。
以色列国防部长将事件称为“企图发动的圣战主义恐怖袭击”，但BBC指出警方、急救部门和调查人员尚未公布动机，因此该定性仍属于相关官员的说法而非已证实事实。
乘客和官员对机上人数的说法不完全一致：报道提到至少150人，内塔尼亚胡又称受影响人数为174人；文章未解释统计口径差异。
关于谁实际控制飞机、乘客在驾驶舱内采取了何种具体行动，不同乘客叙述存在差异；部分细节主要来自个人回忆或政府办公室发布的视频。
机组人员构成的细节不一致或不完整：一名乘客称一名降落飞机的飞行员为英国人、另一人为欧洲人，但未提供可核实的具体身份。
blindSpots: 尚无公开的警方或调查机构结论说明涉事飞行员的身份、动机、精神状态、是否预谋以及事件的法律性质。
报道未提供驾驶舱录音、机载数据、客舱监控或完整空管记录，无法独立核实“企图坠机”、飞机失控程度及各方在驾驶舱内的具体行为。
没有详细说明受伤飞行员的伤情、涉事嫌疑人的伤情、两名飞行员之间的关系及其工作背景。
对沙特方面的逮捕、审讯和调查程序报道有限，也未说明案件由哪个司法或安全机构负责。
报道主要引用以色列官员和乘客叙述，对沙特、阿联酋、Flydubai内部记录及其他机组成员的独立说法覆盖不足。
事件对乘客心理健康、后续医疗支持和航空安全程序改进的影响尚未展开。
文章没有充分解释以色列和沙特战机出动的具体原因、时间线及是否与该航班的应答机信号直接相关。

worldStories.title: 安妮·海瑟薇在《Verity》红毯上掌控全场，瞬间走红
worldStories.originalTitle: Anne Hathaway takes charge at the 'Verity' red carpet in viral moment
worldStories.snippet: Anne Hathaway's viral red carpet video shows her directing photographers during the "Verity" premiere while debuting her baby bump in Prabal Gurung.
worldStories.fullContent:
Anne Hathaway took control of the red carpet while at the premiere of her latest film.

While posing with the cast of her new film, "Verity," the 43-year-old actress calmly instructed photographers on how she planned on posing for their photos, in order to get the best shot possible.

In videos from the red carpet, Hathaway is heard telling the photographers where she will be looking and when, and tells the whole cast to follow suit.

The video from the premiere went viral on social media, with many fans praising her ability to get the photo taken efficiently.

ANNE HATHAWAY, DAKOTA JOHNSON AND JOSH HARTNETT STAR IN R-RATED THRILLER ‘VERITY,’ OUT OCT 2

"Anne saw the group photo drifting and took the wheel immediately," one X user wrote, while another added, "She really said fine ill do it myself and honestly thats the energy every group photo needs."

Another fan took to the comments section on Facebook, writing, " Queen of Genovia knows best," with a fourth fan adding, "She's like "this dress and my ankles have a TIME LIMIT. let's make this EFFICIENT!!!"

Hathaway showed off her baby bump in a figure-hugging black mermaid gown designed by Prabal Gurung, which featured sequins, beading and a long sheer cape.

WATCH: Anne Hathaway directed photographers at the red carpet premiere of 'Verity'

This isn't the first time Hathaway has been recorded telling photographers what to do. A video of her greeting fans and paparazzi outside Valentino's fall 2022 show in Italy by telling them to "calma" went viral and became an audio trend, something Hathaway didn't expect.

GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE

LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS

"I remember that particular time, we were coming out of the pandemic so we were all feeling a little fragile," she told W Magazine in February 2024 about the viral video. "Like I said, so many of my fans learned about me when they were children. So their excitement comes from a pure place. I want them to know, I’m excited too. I feel like, if we can be calm in meeting each other, we’ll both be able to connect that much more significantly."

Hathaway is currently pregnant with her third child with her husband, Adam Shulman. The two tied the knot in September 2012 and share two sons; Jonathan and Jack.

The "Princess Diaries" star announced her third pregnancy on Instagram, in June, and debuted her baby bump on the red carpet at the world premiere of "The Odyssey" in London, England in July.

Her latest film, "Verity," which she stars in alongside Dakota Johnson and Josh Hartnett, is the fifth feature film the actress starred in this year. Her other films this year include "The End of Oak Street," "The Devil Wears Prada 2," "The Odyssey" and "Mother Mary."

PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE

"It’s exciting, but it’s not like I planned it this way," she told The New Indian Express in August. " The five films are the proceeds of more than three years of work. It just so happens they are all out this year. Years ago, I would probably have been pretty stressed about that, but now I’m not. It’s fun to be here talking about films that I am so proud of."
worldStories.fullTranslation:
安妮·海瑟薇在最新主演电影的首映礼上掌控了红毯现场。

这位43岁的女演员与新片《Verity》的演员阵容一起摆 pose 时，镇定地指导摄影师，告诉他们自己打算如何摆姿势，以便拍出尽可能好的照片。

红毯视频中可以听到海瑟薇告诉摄影师自己将在何时看向哪里，并让全体演员照做。

首映礼视频在社交媒体上走红，许多粉丝称赞她高效完成拍摄的能力。

安妮·海瑟薇、达科塔·约翰逊和乔什·哈奈特主演限制级惊悚片《Verity》，10月2日上映

一名X用户写道：“安妮看到合照现场开始失控，立刻接管了局面。”另一人补充说：“她真的像是在说，‘行吧，我自己来’，而说实话，每张集体照都需要这种能量。”

另一名粉丝在Facebook评论区写道：“吉诺维亚女王最懂。”第四名粉丝补充道：“她就像在说，‘这条裙子和我的脚踝都有时间限制。让我们高效一点！！！’”

海瑟薇身穿Prabal Gurung设计的修身黑色美人鱼礼服，展示了自己的孕肚。这件礼服饰有亮片、珠饰和一条长款透视披风。

观看：安妮·海瑟薇在《Verity》红毯首映礼上指导摄影师

这并不是海瑟薇第一次被拍到指导摄影师该怎么做。2022年秋季，海瑟薇在意大利参加Valentino时装秀时，曾一边向现场的粉丝和狗仔队打招呼，一边让他们“calma”（冷静），相关视频走红并成为网络音频潮流，而这并非海瑟薇所预料到的结果。

2024年2月，她在接受《W Magazine》采访时谈到那段走红视频：“我记得那段特殊时期，当时我们刚刚走出疫情，所以大家都觉得有些脆弱。就像我说的那样，我的很多粉丝从小就认识我。所以，他们的兴奋来自一个纯粹的地方。我希望他们知道，我也同样兴奋。我觉得，如果我们在彼此见面时能够保持冷静，我们双方就能建立更有意义的联系。”

海瑟薇目前正怀着与丈夫亚当·舒尔曼的第三个孩子。两人于2012年9月结婚，育有两个儿子：乔纳森和杰克。

这位《公主日记》主演于今年6月在Instagram上宣布自己第三次怀孕，并于7月在英国伦敦举行的《奥德赛》全球首映红毯上首次公开孕肚。

她的最新电影《Verity》与达科塔·约翰逊和乔什·哈奈特共同主演，是这位女演员今年主演的第五部故事片。她今年出演的其他电影包括《橡树街尽头》《穿普拉达的女王2》《奥德赛》和《圣母玛利亚》。

她在8月接受《新印度快报》采访时说：“这令人兴奋，但这并不是我刻意安排成这样的。这五部电影是三年多工作的成果。只是碰巧它们都在今年上映。几年前，我可能会因此感到相当焦虑，但现在不会了。能够在这里谈论这些令我无比自豪的电影，感觉很棒。”

worldStories.title: 南美航空集团荣获《航空运输世界》“年度最佳航空公司”称号
worldStories.originalTitle: Latam eletta compagnia aerea dell'anno da Air Transport World
worldStories.source: ANSA Mondo (意大利安莎社官方意大利文)
worldStories.snippet: È la prima compagnia latinoamericana a ricevere il riconoscimento
worldStories.fullContent:
Latam Airlines Group è stata eletta "Compagnia aerea dell'anno" dall'Air Transport World (Atw), nella principale categoria degli Atw Airline Industry Achievement Awards, diventando la prima compagnia aerea latinoamericana a ottenere il riconoscimento nella storia del premio, istituito nel 1974. Il riconoscimento sarà consegnato il 10 dicembre a Milano, durante la cerimonia della 52/a edizione, e sarà ritirato dal ceo di Latam Airlines Group, Roberto Alvo. La giuria, composta da editor e analisti di Atw, Aviation Week e Centre for Aviation (Capa), ha premiato la compagnia per i risultati finanziari, la gestione, il contributo alla crescita della connettività aerea in America Latina e nel mondo, l'impegno per la sostenibilità e le attività nel trasporto aereo di merci. Latam opera nei mercati domestici di Brasile, Cile, Colombia, Ecuador e Perù e ha collegamenti internazionali con Europa, Stati Uniti, Oceania, Africa e Caraibi.

Riproduzione riservata © Copyright ANSA
worldStories.fullTranslation:
南美航空集团（Latam Airlines Group）在《航空运输世界》（ATW）举办的“ATW航空业成就奖”核心类别中被评选为“年度最佳航空公司”，成为该奖项自1974年设立以来首家获此殊荣的拉美航空公司。该奖项将于12月10日在米兰举行的第52届颁奖典礼上正式颁发，届时南美航空集团首席执行官罗伯托·阿尔沃（Roberto Alvo）将出席领奖。由ATW、《航空周刊》（Aviation Week）以及亚太航空中心（CAPA）的编辑和分析师组成的评审团对该航司予以表彰，理由是其出色的财务表现、管理水平、对促进拉丁美洲及全球航空互联互通作出的贡献、对可持续发展的承诺以及在航空货运领域的业务表现。南美航空在巴西、智利、哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔和秘鲁等国运营国内航线，并拥有通往欧洲、美国、大洋洲、非洲和加勒比海地区的国际航线。

worldStories.title: 《五人秀》连续20个季度领跑有线电视新闻，福克斯新闻收视超过CNN与MS NOW之和
worldStories.originalTitle: 'The Five' leads cable news for 20th straight quarter as Fox News outdraws CNN and MS NOW combined
worldStories.snippet: "The Five" marked its 20th consecutive quarter as cable news' top show while Fox News Channel outdrew both MS NOW and CNN combined.
worldStories.fullContent:
Fox News Channel continued to dominate ahead of its 30th anniversary , finishing the third quarter of 2026 ahead of CBS among weekday primetime viewers while crushing all of cable.

Fox News averaged 2.4 million weekday primetime viewers to beat CBS for the quarter while continuing to lead the broadcast network year-to-date among weekday primetime viewers.

When it comes to cable, Fox News averaged 1.3 million total-day viewers to finish as the only network to crack the one-million viewer benchmark. MS NOW finished second with an average audience of 592,000 followed by ESPN, CNN and HGTV.

FIRST LADY MELANIA TRUMP, FOX CORPORATION ANNOUNCE LANDMARK STRATEGIC ALLIANCE TO GROW FOSTERING THE FUTURE

During primetime, Fox News averaged 2.1 million viewers compared to 1.1 million for second-place ESPN. MS NOW settled for 930,000 and CNN managed only 607,000 as Fox News outdrew them combined in both categories.

Along the way, Fox News commanded 56% of the audience in total day and 57% during primetime.

"The Five," with Dana Perino, Greg Gutfeld, Jesse Watters, Emily Compagno, Jessica Tarlov and Harold Ford Jr., averaged 3.1 million viewers to finish as the No. 1 show on cable news. It was the 20th consecutive quarter that "The Five" has been the highest-rated show in cable news.

"Jesse Watters Primetime," "Gutfeld!," "Special Report with Bret Baier," "Hannity" and "The Ingraham Angle" rounded out the top six as Fox News offerings nearly swept the top 14 cable news programs. Fox News is on pace for its highest-rated midterm election year in network history with total day viewership.

The only non-Fox News program to finish inside the top 14 was MS NOW’s "The Rachel Maddow Show," which only airs once per week. "Maddow" averaged 1.9 million viewers to finish seventh, but only aired 10 episodes the entire quarter compared to 59 for "The Five."

CNN’s most-watched show was "Newsnight," which averaged 686,000 viewers to finish No. 24 among cable news programs.

"America’s Newsroom with Bill Hemmer and Dana Perino," "The Faulkner Focus," "Outnumbered," "America Reports with Sandra Smith and John Roberts," Martha MacCallum’s "The Story" and "The Will Cain Show" all had strong quarters as Fox News’ daytime lineup added to the network’s overwhelming success.

FOX NEWS DIGITAL THUMPS ALL NEWS BRANDS, INCLUDING BROADCAST NETWORKS, IN KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS DURING JULY

"Fox News @ Night with Trace Gallagher" averaged 1.3 million viewers to lead its timeslot, and "Gutfeld!" beat all broadcast and late-night television, including ABC’s "Jimmy Kimmel Live!" and NBC’s "The Tonight Show starring Jimmy Fallon."

"FOX & Friends" remained the most-watched morning show in cable news throughout the quarter with 1.1 million viewers, beating "CBS Mornings" in 21 markets, including New York, Philadelphia, Atlanta and Washington, D.C.

"FOX News Saturday Night with Jimmy Failla," "The Big Weekend Show," "My View with Lara Trump," "Life, Liberty & Levin," "The Sunday Briefing," hosted by rotating anchors Peter Doocy and Jacqui Heinrich, "Sunday Night in America with Trey Gowdy" and "One Nation with Brian Kilmeade" all thrived as Fox News continued to shine on weekends.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE OF MEDIA AND CULTURE

"Saturday in America with Kayleigh McEnany" was the most-watched cable news show on Saturdays with 1.4 million viewers, while "Sunday Morning Futures" averaged 1.4 million viewers to take the Sunday title.

Fox News also led cable news in the quarter among the advertiser-coveted demo of adults age 25-54, averaging 120,000 total day demo viewers and 183,000 during primetime. "The Five" averaged 289,000 to finish as the No. 1 show in the critical category.

Data courtesy of Nielsen Media Research.
worldStories.fullTranslation:
福克斯新闻频道在即将迎来成立30周年之际继续占据主导地位。2026年第三季度，该频道在工作日黄金时段观众数量上超过CBS，同时全面压倒所有有线电视网。

本季度，福克斯新闻工作日黄金时段平均观众人数为240万，超过CBS；按今年迄今的工作日黄金时段观众人数计算，该频道也继续领先于广播电视网。

在有线电视领域，福克斯新闻全天平均观众人数为130万，成为唯一一家突破百万观众门槛的电视网。MS NOW以平均59.2万名观众排名第二，随后依次为ESPN、CNN和HGTV。

美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普与福克斯公司宣布具有里程碑意义的战略联盟，以推动“培育未来”项目发展

在黄金时段，福克斯新闻平均观众人数为210万，而排名第二的ESPN为110万。MS NOW为93万，CNN仅为60.7万；在这两个统计类别中，福克斯新闻的观众人数都超过了两者之和。

一路以来，福克斯新闻占据全天观众总数的56%，黄金时段观众的57%。

由达娜·佩里诺、格雷格·古特菲尔德、杰西·沃特斯、艾米莉·康帕尼奥、杰西卡·塔洛夫和小哈罗德·福特主持的《五人秀》平均观众人数为310万，成为有线电视新闻领域排名第一的节目。这是《五人秀》连续第20个季度成为有线电视新闻收视率最高的节目。

《杰西·沃特斯黄金时段》《古特菲尔德！》《布雷特·拜尔特别报道》《汉尼提》和《英格拉汉姆角》位列前六，使福克斯新闻的节目几乎包揽有线电视新闻收视率前14名。按全天观众人数计算，福克斯新闻有望迎来该电视网历史上收视率最高的中期选举年。

唯一跻身前14名的非福克斯新闻节目是MS NOW的《蕾切尔·玛多秀》，该节目每周仅播出一次。《玛多秀》平均观众人数为190万，排名第七，但整个季度仅播出10集，而《五人秀》播出了59集。

CNN收视最高的节目是《Newsnight》，平均观众人数为68.6万，在有线电视新闻节目中排名第24。

《比尔·海默与达娜·佩里诺的美国新闻编辑室》《福克纳焦点》《人数压倒》《桑德拉·史密斯与约翰·罗伯茨的美国报道》、玛莎·麦卡勒姆主持的《故事》以及《威尔·凯恩秀》均取得强劲季度表现；福克斯新闻的日间节目阵容进一步助推了该电视网的压倒性成功。

福克斯新闻数字平台7月在关键绩效指标上力压所有新闻品牌，包括广播电视网

《福克斯新闻夜间时段：特雷斯·加拉格尔主持》平均观众人数为130万，领跑所在时段；《古特菲尔德！》则击败所有广播电视及深夜电视节目，包括ABC的《吉米·坎摩尔直播》和NBC的《吉米·法伦今夜秀》。

《福克斯与朋友们》整个季度继续以110万观众成为有线电视新闻领域收视最高的早间节目，并在包括纽约、费城、亚特兰大和华盛顿特区在内的21个市场击败《CBS早间》。

financeStories.title: 我以4亿美元出售TOMS Shoes后，被误诊为双相情感障碍——这几乎让我失去了一切
financeStories.originalTitle: After I sold TOMS Shoes for $400 million I was misdiagnosed with bipolar disorder — and it almost cost me everything
financeStories.stance: 国际资本与华尔街视角
financeStories.snippet: Most people land in a psychiatrist’s office because something happened: a loss, a breakup, the end of a career.
financeStories.fullContent:
After I sold TOMS Shoes for $400 million I was misdiagnosed with bipolar disorder — and it almost cost me everything

A few years ago, at a dinner party, I told a psychiatrist my story. I had built TOMS into a global company, sold it in 2014 and then fallen into a depression I couldn’t shake for four years. She gave me the answer I had been waiting for: I was bipolar. The success had been mania, and the collapse was the other side of it. The right medications would make me feel great.

I was thrilled. I went around telling friends, “Guess what? I’m bipolar.” After years of feeling bad without knowing why, someone had finally given my pain a name.
financeStories.fullTranslation:
我以4亿美元出售TOMS Shoes后，被误诊为双相情感障碍——这几乎让我失去了一切

几年前的一次晚宴上，我向一位精神科医生讲述了自己的经历。我把TOMS打造成为一家全球性公司，于2014年将其出售，之后却陷入了一场持续四年、始终无法摆脱的抑郁。她给出了我一直等待的答案：我患有双相情感障碍。那段成功经历其实是躁狂发作，而随后的崩溃则是另一面。只要使用正确的药物，我就会感觉非常好。

我欣喜若狂。之后我逢人便说：“你猜怎么着？我患有双相情感障碍。”多年来，我一直感觉很糟，却不知道原因；终于有人为我的痛苦赋予了一个名称。

financeStories.title: Factory首席执行官指责其风险投资董事会顾问为Cognition充当商业间谍
financeStories.originalTitle: Factory CEO just accused his VC board advisor of spying for Cognition
financeStories.snippet: VC Chris Degnan and former board advisor to Factory AI has taken a job as chief revenue officer for Cognition.
financeStories.fullContent:
Matan Grinberg, co-founder and CEO of the AI coding startup Factory, said in a post on X on Wednesday that he fired VC Chris Degnan from role as a board advisor. Grinberg alleges that Degnan shared confidential information with Factory’s biggest competitor, Cognition.

Two hours later, Degnan announced on both X and LinkedIn that he has joined Cognition as its chief revenue officer.

Degnan was Snowflake’s first sales hire and later spent 11 years as the data company’s chief revenue officer. He has spent the last five months as a partner with RPT Partners, a Newport Beach, California-based investor in Factory. Degnan’s LinkedIn account also says he is a go-to-market advisor to startups for the much bigger venture firm Iconiq, a role that dates back to October of last year.

Three-old, San Francisco-based Factory is an agentic coding startup whose AI agents can carry out programming tasks largely on their own. The company raised $200 million at a $5 billion valuation this month from Blackstone, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Insight Partners and others. Its customers include Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada, Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile as customers.

Grinberg said he sees Cognition, maker of the Devin coding agent, as his biggest competitor. Cognition raised another $2 billion at a $48 billion valuation earlier this month, and counts Mercedes-Benz, NASA, Goldman Sachs, and Citi as customers.

Grinberg said on X that Degnan had earlier admitted to having a “casual” conversation with a Cognition executive but had assured Grinberg that he had no interest in working for the competitor. According to Grinberg, Degnan said he had “made too much money” and was “too lazy to go work for Cognition,” which Grinberg said he “trusted and believed.” On Monday, however, Degnan apparently disclosed that he had actually been in ongoing talks with Cognition.

This caused Grinberg to grow concerned over how much confidential information Degnan had about Factory, and how much he had shared and might share in the future with his new employer. He says he fired Degnan from the board on Tuesday, writing:

“For weeks, while he sat in our board meetings and advised our leadership team, he was also confiding with executives of our largest competitor. Chris was subject to confidentiality obligations in connection with his work with Factory. We do not know the extent of the information he shared, but it puts his timely questions about our product roadmap and what the parity gap involves into a new light.”

Degnan’s post announcing his new job at Cognition doesn’t mention Factory. Very notably, it does say that RPT Ventures and the firm’s managing partner, Chad Peets, will now be working with Cognition. “I am thrilled that Chad and the RPT team will be working closely with me in our pursuit of building a generational company,” Degnan wrote.

In the old, pre-AI world, a VC firm was especially cautious not to engage in conflict-of-interest business. In today’s world, many a VC has invested in direct AI competitors, such OpenAI and Anthropic.

Still, there could be consequences for perceived board-level conflicts of interest. VC giant Andreessen Horowitz is reportedly the subject of a Justice Department probe into its partners serving on competitors’ boards.

Grinberg argued that startup founders must be able to rely on their board members. “Chris’s conduct is unacceptable to me. Trust in Board Membership is one of the sacred bonds in the Silicon Valley, one that helps the startup ecosystem thrive. With it comes an enormous responsibility. That trust was violated.”

Degnan, Peets, and Factory did not immediately respond to a request for further comment.

financeStories.fullTranslation:
AI编程初创公司Factory的联合创始人兼首席执行官马坦·格林伯格（Matan Grinberg）周三在X平台发文称，他已解除了风险投资人克里斯·德格南（Chris Degnan）的董事会顾问职务。格林伯格指控德格南向Factory最大的竞争对手Cognition泄露了机密信息。

两小时后，德格南在X平台和领英（LinkedIn）上宣布，他已加入Cognition担任首席营收官（CRO）。

德格南曾是Snowflake招聘的首位销售人员，随后在这家数据公司担任了11年的首席营收官。在过去五个月中，他一直担任RPT Partners的合伙人，这是一家总部位于加州纽波特比奇的机构，也是Factory的投资方。德格南的领英主页还显示，他还是规模更大的风投公司Iconiq的初创企业市场拓展（GTM）顾问，这一任职可追溯至去年10月。

成立三年的Factory总部位于旧金山，是一家智能体（agentic）编程初创公司，其AI智能体在很大程度上能够自主执行编程任务。该公司本月以50亿美元的估值从黑石集团（Blackstone）、Khosla Ventures、红杉资本（Sequoia Capital）、Insight Partners等机构筹集了2亿美元。其客户包括英伟达（Nvidia）、黑石集团、加拿大皇家银行（Royal Bank of Canada）、派拓网络（Palo Alto Networks）、Adobe以及T-Mobile。

格林伯格表示，他将Devin编程智能体的开发商Cognition视作自己最大的竞争对手。Cognition在本月早些时候以480亿美元的估值又筹集了20亿美元，其客户包括梅赛德斯-奔驰（Mercedes-Benz）、美国国家航空航天局（NASA）、高盛（Goldman Sachs）和花旗银行（Citi）。

格林伯格在X上透露，德格南此前曾承认与Cognition的一名高管有过“随意的”交谈，但他向格林伯格保证，自己对去竞争对手那里工作毫无兴趣。格林伯格称，德格南当时表示自己“赚的钱够多了”，“懒得去Cognition工作”，格林伯格说自己“当时对此深信不疑”。然而在周一，德格南显然透露了他实际上一直在与Cognition保持沟通。

这引发了格林伯格的担忧：德格南到底掌握了多少关于Factory的机密信息，以及他已经与新雇主分享了多少、未来还可能分享多少。格林伯格表示，他已于周二将德格南从董事会解职，并写道：

“数周以来，当他参加我们的董事会会议并向我们的领导团队提供建议时，他同时也在向我们最大竞争对手的高管吐露内情。克里斯在Factory任职期间负有保密义务。我们尚不清楚他泄露了多少信息，但这让他此前针对我们的产品路线图以及功能差距所涉及内容提出的那些恰到好处的提问，有了全新的解读意味。”

德格南宣布入职Cognition的帖子中并未提及Factory。但非常引人注目的是，帖子确实提到RPT Ventures以及该公司的管理合伙人查德·皮茨（Chad Peets）现在将与Cognition合作。德格南写道：“查德和RPT团队将与我紧密合作，共同致力于打造一家跨时代的伟大公司，这让我感到非常兴奋。”

在AI浪潮之前的传统时代，风投机构在规避利益冲突业务方面尤为谨慎。而在当今时代，许多风险投资机构都同时投资了直接竞争的AI对手，例如同时投资OpenAI和Anthropic。

不过，董事会层面的潜在利益冲突仍可能带来法律后果。据报道，风投巨头安德森·霍洛维茨（Andreessen Horowitz）正面临美国司法部的调查，调查内容即涉及其合伙人在竞争对手的董事会中任职。

格林伯格强调，初创企业创始人必须能够信赖其董事会成员。“克里斯的行为在我看来是不可接受的。对董事会成员身份的信任是硅谷神圣的纽带之一，它助力了初创企业生态系统的繁荣。伴随这种信任而来的是巨大的责任。而这种信任遭到了践踏。”

德格南、皮茨以及Factory均未立即回应置评请求。

financeStories.snippet: Spotify founder Daniel Ek’s Neko Health raised $700 million to build a business around scanning your body, but it’s not the only company centering its roadmap around a new kind of preventative healthcare. financeStories.fullContent:
Spotify founder Daniel Ek’s Neko Health raised $700 million to build a business around scanning your body, but it’s not the only company centering its roadmap around a new kind of preventative healthcare. Midjourney is building its own body scanner, while Function Health has also raised significant capital to build out its preventative-health platform. Why are investors betting so big on this category?

On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Dominic-Madori Davis talks with Farooq Abbasi, founder and general partner of Preface Ventures and an investor in Neko Health, about how Neko compares with other consumer-health startups. They discuss what has to happen for body scanning to become part of the broader healthcare system.

Spotify 创始人丹尼尔·埃克（Daniel Ek）旗下的 Neko Health 筹集了 7 亿美元，致力于围绕人体全身扫描打造商业模式，但它并不是唯一一家将发展蓝图聚焦于新型预防性医疗健康的公司。Midjourney 正在打造自己的全身扫描仪，而 Function Health 也筹集了大量资金以构建其预防性健康平台。为什么投资者会在这一赛道上押下如此重注？

在本期 TechCrunch 的 Equity 播客节目中，多米尼克-马多里·戴维斯（Dominic-Madori Davis）与 Preface Ventures 创始人兼总合伙人、Neko Health 投资者法鲁克·阿巴斯（Farooq Abbasi）探讨了 Neko 与其他消费级医疗健康初创公司的异同。他们还讨论了全身扫描要成为更广泛医疗保健体系的一部分所必须具备的条件。

financeStories.title: 寻找 Bug
financeStories.fullContent:
Are generative (randomized) tests significantly more effective than example-based unit-tests at discovering bugs? There’s an interesting discussion about this on lobste.rs. One argument in favor of unit tests is, paraphrasing

My generic fuzzer wasn’t able to find this tricky bug in Rust regex crate.

To me, it seems that generative testing should shake out that particular creature, so I wrote a lil fuzzer of my own, and it indeed discovered another bug in that version of regex, and then the one I was after. I didn’t find anything in the latest version. I like to do a write up about the process, as it is a good case study for how one approaches a problem like this.

I want to be extra clear that my argument is very weak here, as I know exactly the bug I am after, and I even know that fuzzers can find it. My primary goal is to teach you the techniques, leaving it to your judgment just how effective they are. That being said, I think finding a second bug validates the approach somewhat.

I also want to emphasize that writing fuzzers to find known bugs is far from an idle amusement. While I believe that generative testing is very powerful, relative to its cost, it’s always a question whether a particular test is thorough enough. And it never is, you will find more bugs elsewhere (that’s why defense in depth and runtime mitigations are critical). And, whenever you have a pest that dodged your fuzzers, your first order of business is to treat this event as a bug in the fuzzer, and change it so that it can find this and related bugs. Only then you are allowed to add a fix and a unit test!

For ".abb|b" regex and "zabb" input, an older version of regex crate returned b as the first match, which is incorrect, because the entire zabb matches:

How do we find this, or something like this?

Regular expression engines are one of the easiest things to apply generative testing to, they are pure algorithms. While few large systems are just an algorithm, algorithms are everywhere inside components of interesting systems, so this is a hands-on knowledge.

And by far the most important technique for testing algorithms is to compare with the known right answer, with an oracle. Implement both O(N log N) and O(N^2) versions of the algorithm, and match the answers.

To be fair, the original comment mentioned that the their fuzzer didn’t find the issue because they didn’t have access to an oracle. However, if you are designing a reliable system, it’s part of your job to ensure it has an oracle! One of the first things we did for our Jepsen test at TigerBeetle was to expose internal timestamps via API, to make it easier for Jepsen to find bugs (TigerBeetle is co-designed with its internal simulator VOPR which naturally has access to timestamps and anything else). And for, a regex engine, coming up with an oracle shouldn’t be hard, as they typically already come with multiple specialized implementations under a single facade, and the implementations can be cross-checked against each other.

But the regex case is even simpler (which makes it an excellent case study). There’s regex_lite crate that provides the same API.

So here’s a plan: generate a regular expression, an input text, and check that regex and regex_lite give identical answers.

I’ll start with code that generates a random string, as it is simpler, but still shows some non-trivial ideas. First, we’ll need a random number generator:

There are fancier techniques, which can give you test-case minimization, exhaustive search, or coverage guided exploration, but the insight is that even a humble PRNG is brutally effective, if you put it to good use.

When you start with randomized testing, the instinct is to generate something big, no, HUGE! Surely regex will choke on 5 GiBs of input? This is usually a wrong call. Bugs usually involve small, but tricky examples, weaponizing interactions between a few features. A string where all characters are the same is more likely to trigger a bug than a purely random string where every character is unique.

So my default approach to generating strings is this. First, I fix the alphabet of possible characters. A nice way to get one is to sort | unique all the unit tests. Then, for each particular string, I pick a subset of that alphabet. I want strings that use all the characters, but I also want long strings with only a and b! Then I generate a string using the given subset of the alphabet, where the length of the string is also picked at random.

To make fuzzing efficient, I want to keep each iteration as fast as possible, so I make sure to re-use the memory across iterations, static allocation in the small:

There’s a nice way to think about this two step process, generating alphabet first, and then generating a string. To generate a string, you need a distribution of characters. You can use the same distribution for each of the million iterations. But an easy way to spice things up is to make the distribution itself random. I file this “randomize distributions themselves” idea under swarm testing.

Let’s apply the same tricks when generating a regex:

Let’s start with the first one:

Regexes have alternation r1|r2, repetition r*, wildcard ., and literals a. Rather then binary enabling or disabling a particular feature, I assign each feature a weight between 0 and 100, which is a bit more general. The sum is the total of all weights. To select a feature at random, we need to generate a number in 0..sum and find which segment it falls into.

In anything more serious, I’d introduce explicit types for probabilities and distributions, but just a two-digit number is perfectly serviceable in the small.

This is how I generate ReOptions, making sure that literals always have non-zero weight, and also selecting an alphabet for them:

So now we can generate a regular expression. This is convenient to do recursively. To avoid allocations, an output buffer is passed through. To control regex length, a size parameter is also threaded, and “branching” recursive invocations divide the size between the children:

Given that compiling regular expressions is somewhat slow, it seems like a good idea to try multiple strings for the same pair of regular expressions, which gives the following code:

It produces examples similar to those in the issue, with a common suffix:

but also examples which somewhat different, without the shared suffix:

financeStories.fullTranslation:
在发现 bug 方面，生成式（随机化）测试是否显著优于基于示例的单元测试？在 lobste.rs 上有一个关于此问题的有趣讨论。支持单元测试的一个论点大致如下：
“我的通用模糊测试器（fuzzer）未能在 Rust 的 regex crate 中发现这个棘手的 bug。”
在我看来，生成式测试本应能揪出那个特定的问题，所以我自己写了一个小型的模糊测试器，而它确实在那版 regex 中发现了另一个 bug，随后又找到了我最初想找的那个 bug。不过在最新版本中我没有发现任何问题。我想把这个过程写成一篇文章，因为对于如何处理此类问题而言，这是一个很好的案例研究。
我需要特别说明的是，我这里的论证力度其实很弱，因为我非常清楚自己要找的是哪个 bug，而且我也预先知道模糊测试器能够找到它。我的主要目标是向你介绍这些技术，至于它们究竟有多有效，留给你自行判断。话虽如此，我认为找到第二个 bug 在一定程度上验证了这种方法的有效性。
我还想强调的是，编写模糊测试器来寻找已知 bug 绝非无事生非的消遣。虽然我认为生成式测试相对于其成本而言非常强大，但某个特定测试是否足够彻底始终是个问题。而且它永远谈不上彻底，你总会在其他地方发现更多 bug（这也是为什么纵深防御和运行时缓解措施至关重要）。每当有漏网之鱼避开了你的模糊测试器时，你的首要任务就是将此情况视为模糊测试器自身的一个 bug，并对其进行修改，使其能够找出该 bug 及相关 bug。只有在这之后，你才被允许添加修复代码和单元测试！
对于正则表达式 ".abb|b" 和输入 "zabb"，较早版本的 regex crate 将 b 作为第一个匹配项返回，这是不正确的，因为整个 zabb 都能匹配：
我们该如何发现这个 bug，或者类似的问题呢？
正则表达式引擎是应用生成式测试最容易的对象之一，因为它们是纯算法。虽然大型系统中很少有完全由单一算法构成的，但算法在各种有趣系统的组件中无处不在，因此这是一项实用的实践知识。
而到目前为止，测试算法最重要的技术就是将其与已知的正确答案（即预言机，oracle）进行比对。同时实现该算法的 O(N log N) 和 O(N^2) 版本，并比对它们的结果。
平心而论，最初的那条评论提到他们的模糊测试器之所以没能发现问题，是因为他们无法使用预言机。然而，如果你正在设计一个高可靠系统，确保其具备预言机本就是你的本职工作之一！在 TigerBeetle，我们为 Jepsen 测试所做的第一批工作之一就是通过 API 暴露内部时间戳，以便 Jepsen 更容易发现 bug（TigerBeetle 与其内部模拟器 VOPR 进行了协同设计，而 VOPR 自然能够访问时间戳以及其他所有数据）。对于正则表达式引擎而言，构思一个预言机并不困难，因为它们通常已经在单一外观接口下内置了多种专门的实现，这些实现可以相互交叉验证。
但 regex 的情况甚至更为简单（这也使其成为一个绝佳的案例研究）。社区中有一个提供了相同 API 的 regex_lite crate。
因此计划如下：生成一个正则表达式和一个输入文本，然后检查 regex 和 regex_lite 是否给出完全相同的结果。
我将从生成随机字符串的代码开始，因为它比较简单，但仍然能展现一些不平凡的想法。首先，我们需要一个随机数生成器：
虽然存在更花哨的技术（能够为你提供测试用例最小化、穷举搜索或覆盖引导的探索），但核心认知在于：即便是一个朴素的伪随机数生成器（PRNG），只要善加利用，其效果也是极其显著的。
当你开始接触随机化测试时，本能往往是去生成某种规模庞大的输入——不，是极其庞大的输入！regex 面对 5 GiB 的输入肯定会崩溃吧？这种思路通常是错误的。Bug 通常涉及体量小却构思巧妙的示例，它们通过结合少数几个特性之间的相互作用来触发问题。一个所有字符都相同的字符串，往往比每个字符都独一无二的纯随机字符串更容易触发 bug。
因此，我生成字符串的默认方法是这样的。首先，我固定可能字符的字符集字母表。获取它的一个好方法是对所有单元测试中的字符进行 sort | unique。然后，针对每个具体的字符串，我从该字母表中挑选一个子集。我既想要包含所有字符的字符串，也想要仅由 a 和 b 组成的长字符串！接着，我使用给定的字母表子集生成字符串，字符串的长度也是随机选取的。
为了使模糊测试保持高效，我希望每次迭代都尽可能快速，因此我确保在各次迭代间复用内存，在局部实现静态分配：
对于这种先生成字母表、再生成字符串的两步流程，有一种很好的理解方式。生成字符串时，你需要字符的分布概率。你可以在上百万次迭代中每次都使用相同的分布。但让测试变得更加多样的简便方法是让分布本身也随机化。我把这种“将分布本身随机化”的想法归类为群测试（swarm testing）。
让我们在生成正则表达式时应用相同的技巧：
我们先从第一个开始：
正则表达式具有分支 r1|r2、重复 r*、通配符 . 以及字面量 a。我没有采用非开即关的二元方式来启用或禁用某个特定特性，而是为每个特性分配了一个介于 0 到 100 之间的权重，这样更通用一些。sum 是所有权重的总和。为了随机选择一个特性，我们需要生成一个介于 0..sum 之间的数字，并查看它落在哪个区间。
在更严肃的工程中，我会为概率和分布引入显式类型，但就局部小规模而言，一个两位数就完全够用了。
这就是我生成 ReOptions 的方式，确保字面量始终具有非零权重，并为它们选择一个字母表：
现在我们就可以生成正则表达式了。采用递归方式实现会很方便。为了避免内存分配，输出缓冲区会被传递下去。为了控制正则表达式的长度，还需要传递一个大小参数，并且“分支”递归调用会在子节点之间分配该大小：
鉴于编译正则表达式的速度相对较慢，对同一对正则表达式尝试多个字符串似乎是个好主意，由此得出了以下代码：

keyTakeaways: 来源叙事重点：重点是展示如何为算法构造有效的测试预言机，并通过随机生成正则表达式和输入文本、交叉比对不同实现结果来发现错误。文章强调小而刁钻的输入、随机化分布、复用内存、递归生成和多实现交叉验证等工程技巧，同时主张发现已知缺陷也有助于改进模糊测试器。作者明确承认该案例不能充分证明生成式测试普遍优于单元测试。

关注可靠性、缺陷检测和运行时防御的软件系统设计者
consensus: 文章所述旧版本 regex crate 在特定正则表达式和输入组合下返回错误匹配结果，构成具体缺陷案例。
随机化测试的有效性取决于输入生成策略，而不只是随机性本身。
对算法测试而言，能够比较的已知正确答案或独立实现是重要的测试预言机。
测试工具未发现某个缺陷时，不能据此推断系统没有更多缺陷；防御纵深和运行时缓解措施仍然重要。
正则表达式引擎属于较适合应用生成式测试的算法型组件。
disagreements: 文章讨论的核心争议是生成式或随机化测试是否显著比基于示例的单元测试更善于发现缺陷，但文中没有提供足以定量裁决这一问题的对照实验。
文中转述的观点认为通用模糊测试未能发现某个棘手缺陷，而作者认为针对性设计并配备预言机的模糊测试能够发现该缺陷及另一个缺陷；这说明双方对测试配置和工具能力的评价不同。
作者主张在修复缺陷并添加单元测试之前，应先把未发现缺陷视为模糊测试器的问题并改进它；这一优先顺序属于方法论主张，并非文中证明的普遍工程共识。
blindSpots: 没有报告样本规模、运行时长、覆盖率、误报漏报率或与单元测试的对照数据，无法据此判断两类测试的相对总体效果。
案例集中于纯算法型正则表达式引擎，结论对并发、网络、存储、分布式系统或复杂状态系统的适用性未被验证。
使用 regex_lite 或其他实现作为预言机可能共享相同规范误解、实现缺陷或行为差异，独立性和正确性未得到系统论证。
文章主要展示作者成功发现缺陷的过程，未详细讨论模糊测试未发现缺陷、测试成本、维护成本及结果可重复性。
未充分讨论生成式测试与高质量人工设计单元测试的互补关系，也未明确说明何时应优先采用某一种方法。
证据包未提供独立来源、代码运行结果或缺陷修复记录，相关技术细节主要依赖文章作者自己的叙述。

Changing how we work and build at GoogleGemini 4 Argon is already powering our internal workflows, with thousands of Googlers highlighting the model’s strengths in specialized coding tasks, conducting deeper research, and writing quality. It’s helping teams build faster and push the boundaries of engineering productivity and accelerating breakthroughs:

Gemini 4 Argon is already powering our internal workflows, with thousands of Googlers highlighting the model’s strengths in specialized coding tasks, conducting deeper research, and writing quality. It’s helping teams build faster and push the boundaries of engineering productivity and accelerating breakthroughs:

Quantum algorithmic optimization: Argon is helping our quantum computing researchers optimize the spacetime resources (qubits × gates) of subroutines that bottleneck important applications. In one example, it beat the published baseline by 40% in a matter of minutes.

Memory efficiency: A team of Argon agents analyzed fleet-wide profiling telemetry to autonomously identify and apply memory optimizations across Google’s data centers, freeing up over 300 TiB of memory once rolled out, with an estimated 500 TiB to 1 PiB in total savings.

Large Scale Codebase Migrations and Optimizations: Argon agents are working on migrating C/C++ codebases to Rust across Google—scaling from tens of thousands of lines in core libraries like re2, libgav1 up to 800K+ lines for the Fuchsia OS Zircon kernel. Given the criticality of many of these systems, such large-scale rewrites are undergoing rigorous automated and manual auditing, emulation testing, and review before rolling out to production.For libgav1, Google's open source software for decoding video, Argon agents took an existing Rust port and replaced 32K lines of SIMD code by running many rounds of profile-guided experiments, studying the compiler's output, producing safe Rust so the compiler would vectorize it automatically. The end result is a memory-safe video decoder that runs 2.7x faster than the Rust port, with identical video output, bringing it closer to the optimized C++.

Working harder on your most complex problemsTo support Gemini 4 Argon’s capabilities across longer, more complex use cases, we are significantly expanding the model’s output token limit to an industry-leading 1M tokens, up from the previous 64K tokens. When the model has the headroom to think deeply and generate hundreds of thousands of tokens in a single trajectory, it adds a new level of depth in reasoning to solve tough problems in one go.

Enabling coding and enterprise workflows across domainsGemini 4 Argon’s capabilities across coding, reasoning, and multimodality and its ability to sustain long, multi-step tasks enable it to excel across a range of enterprise workflows.Google engineers have been using Argon for their daily tasks, from everyday debugging to large-scale codebase migrations and algorithm designs. It sets a new state of the art on DeepSWE v1.1 (77.9%), which measures a model’s performance in real-world long-horizon software engineering tasks.Beyond coding, Argon is the leading model on the Vals Index, which measures economic impact across finance, coding, legal, and tax work, with every sector weighted by its contribution to U.S. GDP. We see similarly leading performance across other domain specific evaluations, like Vals Finance Agent v2 (multi-step financial research) and Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark (legal research and drafting). On AutomationBench, Zapier’s benchmark measuring end-to-end execution across core business functions, Argon ranks #1 with a score of 51.3%.Argon is also uniquely strong when knowledge work requires visual understanding. It’s able to drive professional chart analysis, identify details from long videos, and take action based on a series of documents. For example, on LVBench, which measures long video understanding, Argon is state of the art with a score of 91.7%.

Leading in defensive cybersecurityTo better equip cyber defenders for the new era of cyberattacks, we trained Gemini 4 Argon to be highly capable at cybersecurity defense. Argon can autonomously find, validate, and patch critical software vulnerabilities. For trusted defenders and our own internal teams at Google, we’ll be releasing Argon without cyber guardrails so they can leverage its full frontier-level cybersecurity defense capabilities.Wiz is already using Argon for cybersecurity defense through its Scan for Good initiative – a program dedicated to protecting critical public infrastructure for free by finding and remediating high-risk exposures. In an early demonstration of its impact, the model uncovered a critical vulnerability exposing sensitive personal information across healthcare software used by hospitals worldwide, identifying a severe risk that previous frontier models had missed.On CWE-bench v1, which evaluates the model’s ability to remediate security vulnerabilities, Argon ties for first place with a top score of 68%, building on 3.8 Flash Cyber’s frontier performance on CWE-bench v0.

Strengthening frontier safeguards before broad availabilityBefore rolling out Gemini 4 Argon broadly, we’re continuing to strengthen critical frontier safeguards across four main areas:Defending against misuse: To prevent bad actors from using Argon for cyber or chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) attacks, the model is designed to refuse harmful requests while preserving legitimate, dual-use scientific research, as per our Frontier Safety Framework. We are strengthening the robustness of our safeguards for this launch, including improving our techniques to monitor the model’s internal activations to spot misuse. These safeguards underwent robustness testing by internal and external red teams using a combination of manual and automated attack methods.Defending against prompt injection attacks: Argon is also our most resilient model yet against indirect prompt injections, where malicious instructions or context are used to hijack a model’s behavior. These are complex attacks that require constant vigilance and multiple layers of defense. Through automated red teaming and adversarial training, Gemini 4 Argon is leading in prompt injection robustness on the Gray Swan’s Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) benchmark.

Before rolling out Gemini 4 Argon broadly, we’re continuing to strengthen critical frontier safeguards across four main areas:

Defending against misuse: To prevent bad actors from using Argon for cyber or chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) attacks, the model is designed to refuse harmful requests while preserving legitimate, dual-use scientific research, as per our Frontier Safety Framework. We are strengthening the robustness of our safeguards for this launch, including improving our techniques to monitor the model’s internal activations to spot misuse. These safeguards underwent robustness testing by internal and external red teams using a combination of manual and automated attack methods.

Defending against prompt injection attacks: Argon is also our most resilient model yet against indirect prompt injections, where malicious instructions or context are used to hijack a model’s behavior. These are complex attacks that require constant vigilance and multiple layers of defense. Through automated red teaming and adversarial training, Gemini 4 Argon is leading in prompt injection robustness on the Gray Swan’s Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) benchmark.

Monitoring for misalignment: In order to prevent Argon from stepping out of bounds to try to accomplish a task in a way that goes beyond the user’s intentions, we are deploying misalignment mitigations that monitor Argon’s chain-of-thought and actions and stop execution when necessary.We used a similar system to monitor our training runs and send alerts to a dedicated incident response team, taking careful precautions against feeding the findings back into training so as to not risk shaping Argon’s reasoning to evade our monitoring. We strongly encourage the rest of the industry to preserve reasoning transparency in these pivotal moments of increased capabilities while navigating alignment risks, so that model thoughts remain helpful in identifying and diagnosing misalignment.Hardening systems: As frontier models grow increasingly capable, safely testing them requires secure environments that can keep up with the systems themselves. In line with our agent control roadmap, we are hardening our sandboxed environments by isolating and sealing them before high-risk training or evaluations begin. We’re committed to sharing these agent security best practices with our partners to improve security across the ecosystem.

financeStories.title: 安妮·海瑟薇在《Verity》红毯上掌控全场，瞬间走红
financeStories.originalTitle: Anne Hathaway takes charge at the 'Verity' red carpet in viral moment
financeStories.snippet: Anne Hathaway's viral red carpet video shows her directing photographers during the "Verity" premiere while debuting her baby bump in Prabal Gurung.
financeStories.fullContent:
Anne Hathaway took control of the red carpet while at the premiere of her latest film.

While posing with the cast of her new film, "Verity," the 43-year-old actress calmly instructed photographers on how she planned on posing for their photos, in order to get the best shot possible.

In videos from the red carpet, Hathaway is heard telling the photographers where she will be looking and when, and tells the whole cast to follow suit.

The video from the premiere went viral on social media, with many fans praising her ability to get the photo taken efficiently.

ANNE HATHAWAY, DAKOTA JOHNSON AND JOSH HARTNETT STAR IN R-RATED THRILLER ‘VERITY,’ OUT OCT 2

"Anne saw the group photo drifting and took the wheel immediately," one X user wrote, while another added, "She really said fine ill do it myself and honestly thats the energy every group photo needs."

Another fan took to the comments section on Facebook, writing, " Queen of Genovia knows best," with a fourth fan adding, "She's like "this dress and my ankles have a TIME LIMIT. let's make this EFFICIENT!!!"

Hathaway showed off her baby bump in a figure-hugging black mermaid gown designed by Prabal Gurung, which featured sequins, beading and a long sheer cape.

WATCH: Anne Hathaway directed photographers at the red carpet premiere of 'Verity'

This isn't the first time Hathaway has been recorded telling photographers what to do. A video of her greeting fans and paparazzi outside Valentino's fall 2022 show in Italy by telling them to "calma" went viral and became an audio trend, something Hathaway didn't expect.

LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS

"I remember that particular time, we were coming out of the pandemic so we were all feeling a little fragile," she told W Magazine in February 2024 about the viral video. "Like I said, so many of my fans learned about me when they were children. So their excitement comes from a pure place. I want them to know, I’m excited too. I feel like, if we can be calm in meeting each other, we’ll both be able to connect that much more significantly."

Hathaway is currently pregnant with her third child with her husband, Adam Shulman. The two tied the knot in September 2012 and share two sons; Jonathan and Jack.

The "Princess Diaries" star announced her third pregnancy on Instagram, in June, and debuted her baby bump on the red carpet at the world premiere of "The Odyssey" in London, England in July.

Her latest film, "Verity," which she stars in alongside Dakota Johnson and Josh Hartnett, is the fifth feature film the actress starred in this year. Her other films this year include "The End of Oak Street," "The Devil Wears Prada 2," "The Odyssey" and "Mother Mary."

"It’s exciting, but it’s not like I planned it this way," she told The New Indian Express in August. " The five films are the proceeds of more than three years of work. It just so happens they are all out this year. Years ago, I would probably have been pretty stressed about that, but now I’m not. It’s fun to be here talking about films that I am so proud of."

安妮·海瑟薇在最新主演电影的首映礼上掌控了红毯现场。

这位43岁的女演员与新片《Verity》的演员阵容一起摆 pose 时，镇定地指导摄影师，告诉他们自己打算如何摆姿势，以便拍出尽可能好的照片。

红毯视频中可以听到海瑟薇告诉摄影师自己将在何时看向哪里，并让全体演员照做。

首映礼视频在社交媒体上走红，许多粉丝称赞她高效完成拍摄的能力。

安妮·海瑟薇、达科塔·约翰逊和乔什·哈奈特主演限制级惊悚片《Verity》，10月2日上映

一名X用户写道：“安妮看到合照现场开始失控，立刻接管了局面。”另一人补充说：“她真的像是在说，‘行吧，我自己来’，而说实话，每张集体照都需要这种能量。”

另一名粉丝在Facebook评论区写道：“吉诺维亚女王最懂。”第四名粉丝补充道：“她就像在说，‘这条裙子和我的脚踝都有时间限制。让我们高效一点！！！’”

海瑟薇身穿Prabal Gurung设计的修身黑色美人鱼礼服，展示了自己的孕肚。这件礼服饰有亮片、珠饰和一条长款透视披风。

观看：安妮·海瑟薇在《Verity》红毯首映礼上指导摄影师

这并不是海瑟薇第一次被拍到指导摄影师该怎么做。2022年秋季，海瑟薇在意大利参加Valentino时装秀时，曾一边向现场的粉丝和狗仔队打招呼，一边让他们“calma”（冷静），相关视频走红并成为网络音频潮流，而这并非海瑟薇所预料到的结果。

2024年2月，她在接受《W Magazine》采访时谈到那段走红视频：“我记得那段特殊时期，当时我们刚刚走出疫情，所以大家都觉得有些脆弱。就像我说的那样，我的很多粉丝从小就认识我。所以，他们的兴奋来自一个纯粹的地方。我希望他们知道，我也同样兴奋。我觉得，如果我们在彼此见面时能够保持冷静，我们双方就能建立更有意义的联系。”

海瑟薇目前正怀着与丈夫亚当·舒尔曼的第三个孩子。两人于2012年9月结婚，育有两个儿子：乔纳森和杰克。

这位《公主日记》主演于今年6月在Instagram上宣布自己第三次怀孕，并于7月在英国伦敦举行的《奥德赛》全球首映红毯上首次公开孕肚。

她的最新电影《Verity》与达科塔·约翰逊和乔什·哈奈特共同主演，是这位女演员今年主演的第五部故事片。她今年出演的其他电影包括《橡树街尽头》《穿普拉达的女王2》《奥德赛》和《圣母玛利亚》。

她在8月接受《新印度快报》采访时说：“这令人兴奋，但这并不是我刻意安排成这样的。这五部电影是三年多工作的成果。只是碰巧它们都在今年上映。几年前，我可能会因此感到相当焦虑，但现在不会了。能够在这里谈论这些令我无比自豪的电影，感觉很棒。”

financeStories.title: 南美航空集团荣获《航空运输世界》“年度最佳航空公司”称号
financeStories.originalTitle: Latam eletta compagnia aerea dell'anno da Air Transport World
financeStories.source: ANSA Mondo (意大利安莎社官方意大利文)
financeStories.snippet: È la prima compagnia latinoamericana a ricevere il riconoscimento
financeStories.fullContent:
Latam Airlines Group è stata eletta "Compagnia aerea dell'anno" dall'Air Transport World (Atw), nella principale categoria degli Atw Airline Industry Achievement Awards, diventando la prima compagnia aerea latinoamericana a ottenere il riconoscimento nella storia del premio, istituito nel 1974. Il riconoscimento sarà consegnato il 10 dicembre a Milano, durante la cerimonia della 52/a edizione, e sarà ritirato dal ceo di Latam Airlines Group, Roberto Alvo. La giuria, composta da editor e analisti di Atw, Aviation Week e Centre for Aviation (Capa), ha premiato la compagnia per i risultati finanziari, la gestione, il contributo alla crescita della connettività aerea in America Latina e nel mondo, l'impegno per la sostenibilità e le attività nel trasporto aereo di merci. Latam opera nei mercati domestici di Brasile, Cile, Colombia, Ecuador e Perù e ha collegamenti internazionali con Europa, Stati Uniti, Oceania, Africa e Caraibi.

financeStories.fullTranslation:
南美航空集团（Latam Airlines Group）在《航空运输世界》（ATW）举办的“ATW航空业成就奖”核心类别中被评选为“年度最佳航空公司”，成为该奖项自1974年设立以来首家获此殊荣的拉美航空公司。该奖项将于12月10日在米兰举行的第52届颁奖典礼上正式颁发，届时南美航空集团首席执行官罗伯托·阿尔沃（Roberto Alvo）将出席领奖。由ATW、《航空周刊》（Aviation Week）以及亚太航空中心（CAPA）的编辑和分析师组成的评审团对该航司予以表彰，理由是其出色的财务表现、管理水平、对促进拉丁美洲及全球航空互联互通作出的贡献、对可持续发展的承诺以及在航空货运领域的业务表现。南美航空在巴西、智利、哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔和秘鲁等国运营国内航线，并拥有通往欧洲、美国、大洋洲、非洲和加勒比海地区的国际航线。

financeStories.originalTitle: 'The Five' leads cable news for 20th straight quarter as Fox News outdraws CNN and MS NOW combined
financeStories.snippet: "The Five" marked its 20th consecutive quarter as cable news' top show while Fox News Channel outdrew both MS NOW and CNN combined.
financeStories.fullContent:
Fox News Channel continued to dominate ahead of its 30th anniversary , finishing the third quarter of 2026 ahead of CBS among weekday primetime viewers while crushing all of cable.

Fox News averaged 2.4 million weekday primetime viewers to beat CBS for the quarter while continuing to lead the broadcast network year-to-date among weekday primetime viewers.

When it comes to cable, Fox News averaged 1.3 million total-day viewers to finish as the only network to crack the one-million viewer benchmark. MS NOW finished second with an average audience of 592,000 followed by ESPN, CNN and HGTV.

FIRST LADY MELANIA TRUMP, FOX CORPORATION ANNOUNCE LANDMARK STRATEGIC ALLIANCE TO GROW FOSTERING THE FUTURE

During primetime, Fox News averaged 2.1 million viewers compared to 1.1 million for second-place ESPN. MS NOW settled for 930,000 and CNN managed only 607,000 as Fox News outdrew them combined in both categories.

Along the way, Fox News commanded 56% of the audience in total day and 57% during primetime.

"The Five," with Dana Perino, Greg Gutfeld, Jesse Watters, Emily Compagno, Jessica Tarlov and Harold Ford Jr., averaged 3.1 million viewers to finish as the No. 1 show on cable news. It was the 20th consecutive quarter that "The Five" has been the highest-rated show in cable news.

"Jesse Watters Primetime," "Gutfeld!," "Special Report with Bret Baier," "Hannity" and "The Ingraham Angle" rounded out the top six as Fox News offerings nearly swept the top 14 cable news programs. Fox News is on pace for its highest-rated midterm election year in network history with total day viewership.

The only non-Fox News program to finish inside the top 14 was MS NOW’s "The Rachel Maddow Show," which only airs once per week. "Maddow" averaged 1.9 million viewers to finish seventh, but only aired 10 episodes the entire quarter compared to 59 for "The Five."

CNN’s most-watched show was "Newsnight," which averaged 686,000 viewers to finish No. 24 among cable news programs.

"America’s Newsroom with Bill Hemmer and Dana Perino," "The Faulkner Focus," "Outnumbered," "America Reports with Sandra Smith and John Roberts," Martha MacCallum’s "The Story" and "The Will Cain Show" all had strong quarters as Fox News’ daytime lineup added to the network’s overwhelming success.

FOX NEWS DIGITAL THUMPS ALL NEWS BRANDS, INCLUDING BROADCAST NETWORKS, IN KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS DURING JULY

"Fox News @ Night with Trace Gallagher" averaged 1.3 million viewers to lead its timeslot, and "Gutfeld!" beat all broadcast and late-night television, including ABC’s "Jimmy Kimmel Live!" and NBC’s "The Tonight Show starring Jimmy Fallon."

"FOX & Friends" remained the most-watched morning show in cable news throughout the quarter with 1.1 million viewers, beating "CBS Mornings" in 21 markets, including New York, Philadelphia, Atlanta and Washington, D.C.

"FOX News Saturday Night with Jimmy Failla," "The Big Weekend Show," "My View with Lara Trump," "Life, Liberty & Levin," "The Sunday Briefing," hosted by rotating anchors Peter Doocy and Jacqui Heinrich, "Sunday Night in America with Trey Gowdy" and "One Nation with Brian Kilmeade" all thrived as Fox News continued to shine on weekends.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE OF MEDIA AND CULTURE

"Saturday in America with Kayleigh McEnany" was the most-watched cable news show on Saturdays with 1.4 million viewers, while "Sunday Morning Futures" averaged 1.4 million viewers to take the Sunday title.

Fox News also led cable news in the quarter among the advertiser-coveted demo of adults age 25-54, averaging 120,000 total day demo viewers and 183,000 during primetime. "The Five" averaged 289,000 to finish as the No. 1 show in the critical category.

Data courtesy of Nielsen Media Research.

financeStories.originalTitle: Hackers stole millions of US military personnel records during months-long data breach
financeStories.snippet: The Department of Defense notified millions of current and former U.S. military personnel that their personal information had been stolen in a months-long breach.
financeStories.fullContent:
The U.S. government is reportedly alerting millions of current and former U.S. military service members and staff that their personal information was stolen during a months-long breach of the Pentagon’s personnel records, the latest in a spate of thefts involving federal workers’ data in recent months.

A data breach notification from the Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC) shared on Reddit says that several unauthorized users exploited a security vulnerability in an unspecified file-sharing system over several months between October 2025 and mid-July 2026.

The breach exposed personally identifiable information, including Social Security numbers, alongside a person’s name, date of birth, sex, race, and other information about their military service. The notice says that the personnel records were unencrypted.

According to CNN and Federal News Network, a Pentagon official said the breach affects about 2.8 million living people, and close to 300,000 people who are deceased.

The U.S. military has 1.3 million active service members as of March.

The DMDC may not be widely known to the general public, but serves as one of the Department of Defense’s records-keeping units. The DMDC maintains over 60 million records for U.S. military and civilian staff and their family members to help determine benefits and entitlements, such as healthcare and retirement. The unit also provides a critical service as the military’s “leading identity management provider,” which links active service members, employees, and contractors to credentials, such as smart cards and passwords. These are used to access Pentagon computer systems, buildings, and bases.

“We make sure that the right people get access and the wrong people don’t: security of identity information is paramount,” the DMDC’s website reads.

The Department of Defense, which oversees the DMDC, said it does not have any indication that the information was misused, but did not say how it reached that conclusion. TechCrunch contacted a Pentagon spokesperson to ask if officials had any communications from the hackers, whose identities are not known, but we did not hear back.

This is the latest major breach of federal workers’ personal information in recent months, following a recent breach at the FBI earlier in September attributed to the ShinyHunters hacking group. The hackers told TechCrunch that they had taken the personal information of most of the FBI’s agents and staffers, including applicants. The breach has been billed as a “counterintelligence disaster” amid the risks that a foreign government could obtain and use the information to profile, target, or coerce federal workers into handing over sensitive information.

The ShinyHunters hackers have said that they will not publicly release the stolen FBI data.

Both breaches involving the FBI and the DMDC mirror similar thefts of government personnel records in the past. In 2015, a breach of the U.S. government’s human resources department, known as the Office of Personnel Management, was broadly attributed to China. The theft allowed the hackers to steal the private records of more than 22 million U.S. government employees, many of whom had security clearances.

据报道，美国政府正在通知数百万名现役和退役美国军人及工作人员：在一次持续数月、涉及五角大楼人员记录的数据泄露事件中，他们的个人信息遭到窃取。这是近几个月来联邦工作人员数据接连被盗事件中的最新一起。

Reddit上分享的一份来自国防人力数据中心（DMDC）的数据泄露通知称，在2025年10月至2026年7月中旬期间，数名未经授权的用户利用了某个未指明的文件共享系统中的安全漏洞，持续数月实施入侵。

此次泄露暴露了个人身份信息，包括社会安全号码，以及个人姓名、出生日期、性别、种族和其他有关其军旅经历的信息。通知称，这些人员记录未经过加密。

据美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）和《联邦新闻网络》报道，一名五角大楼官员表示，此次泄露影响约280万名在世人员，以及近30万名已故人员。

截至3月，美国军方拥有130万名现役军人。

国防人力数据中心可能不为公众广泛知晓，但它是国防部负责记录保存的部门之一。该中心保存着超过6000万份美国军方和文职工作人员及其家属的记录，以帮助确定医疗保健、退休等福利和应享待遇。该部门还提供一项关键服务，作为军方的“主要身份管理服务提供商”，将现役军人、雇员和承包商与智能卡、密码等凭证关联起来。这些凭证用于访问五角大楼的计算机系统、建筑物和基地。

国防人力数据中心网站写道：“我们确保正确的人获得访问权限，错误的人无法访问：身份信息的安全至关重要。”

负责监管国防人力数据中心的国防部表示，没有任何迹象表明这些信息遭到滥用，但没有说明其得出这一结论的依据。TechCrunch联系了一名五角大楼发言人，询问官员是否收到过黑客的任何联系；这些黑客的身份尚不清楚，但截至发稿尚未得到回复。

这是近几个月来联邦工作人员个人信息遭大规模泄露的最新事件。此前，联邦调查局（FBI）在9月初发生了一起近期数据泄露事件，据称与黑客组织ShinyHunters有关。黑客向TechCrunch表示，他们获取了FBI大多数特工和工作人员（包括申请人）的个人信息。在外国政府可能获取并利用这些信息，对联邦工作人员进行画像、锁定目标或胁迫其交出敏感信息的风险下，这起泄露事件被称为一场“反情报灾难”。

ShinyHunters黑客表示，他们不会公开发布窃取的FBI数据。

涉及FBI和国防人力数据中心的这两起事件，与过去政府人员记录遭窃取的类似事件如出一辙。2015年，美国政府人力资源部门——人事管理办公室——发生数据泄露事件，外界普遍认为该事件与中国有关。黑客借此窃取了超过2200万名美国政府雇员的私人记录，其中许多人拥有安全许可。

你是否收到过有关此次数据泄露的通知？我们希望听到你的消息。你可以通过Signal以安全方式联系本报道记者，账号为zackwhittaker.1337；也可以通过电子邮件联系他，邮箱为zack.whittaker@techcrunch.com。

financeStories.title: EDG C++ 前端开源
financeStories.fullContent:
The EDG open source transition

On September 30, 2026, the source for EDG's C++ front end goes public, and The C++ Alliance becomes its nonprofit home. Same engine, same standards, professionally maintained, and open to contributions.

Continuity is the point. This is a change of steward, not a change of course.

For thirty years, EDG's front end has powered C++ compilation across the industry as the only production-quality source-to-source engine of its kind.

This section will cover EDG's founding, the people behind it, the milestones of its front end, and the compilers and tools built on top of it. Have a piece of that history to share? Open an issue on the site's repository.

When the source goes public on September 30, 2026, professional maintenance has to continue. EDG needed a new home that could do three things at once.

Receive and manage donations on behalf of EDG.

Sustain the engineering quality EDG users depend on.

C++ compiler front-end knowledge, from the inside.

The C++ Alliance is a nonprofit with proven fiscal-sponsorship infrastructure, C++ compiler engineers on staff, and deep roots in the C++ standards and Boost communities. It will serve as EDG's nonprofit home.

Learn more about The C++ Alliance

EDG will work like any other open source project: anyone can contribute, and everything that lands is available to everyone. Development follows three tracks: contributions from the user community, ongoing maintenance, and collectively funded features.

Bug fixes and new features from EDG users, submitted as pull requests. Reviewers, who will initially be experienced EDG developers, will evaluate the changes. Once approved, these changes will be merged into the EDG codebase.

Bug fixes and maintenance by the Alliance's EDG developers are published immediately.

To support the EDG community, the Alliance will provide a way for larger features to be developed and funded by the community. In this way, organizations can support the development of larger features financially rather than committing their developers to the development of these features. Once a feature is funded, it is released to everyone at the same time.

One codebase, for everyone. Whichever track a change arrives on, it lands in the same public repository at the same time. No one gets early access.

The Fiscal Sponsorship Committee (FSC) oversees the process across all three tracks. It is chaired by John Spicer and will include volunteers from the EDG user community.

Want a say in who sits on it? See how to get involved.

What this means for you

The engine, the standards it implements, and the person you talk to stay the same. How the work is funded and where the code lives do not.

The transition is under way. Here is what happens next, and how EDG users can take part.

The fiscal sponsorship agreement is ready to sign ahead of the transition date.

Available now to walk any user through the details of the hand-off.

EDG user feedback on the composition of the Fiscal Sponsorship Committee and on development priorities is welcome. The committee will include volunteers from the EDG user community.

Once the source is public, bug fixes and new features from EDG users are welcome as pull requests at github.com/edgcpp. See how contributions are handled.

CppLang Slack for real-time chat. Request an invite, then join the #edgcpp channel.

Any EDG stakeholder can reach the Alliance team, any time. Contact The C++ Alliance.

EDG's source and development are moving to github.com/edgcpp. Watch the organization to follow the transition as it happens.
financeStories.fullTranslation:
EDG 开源转型

2026 年 9 月 30 日，EDG C++ 前端的源代码正式公开，C++ Alliance（C++ 联盟）成为其非营利归属机构。引擎不变、标准不变，由专业团队维护，并向贡献者开放。

连续性才是关键。这是管理者的变更，而不是方向的改变。

三十年来，EDG 前端一直为整个行业的 C++ 编译提供支持，是同类产品中唯一达到生产质量的源到源引擎。

本节将介绍 EDG 的创立历程、幕后人员、其前端的重要里程碑，以及基于它构建的编译器和工具。如果你有相关历史资料愿意分享，请在该网站的代码仓库中提交 issue。

当源代码于 2026 年 9 月 30 日公开后，专业维护必须继续下去。EDG 需要一个能够同时完成三件事的新归属机构：

代表 EDG 接收和管理捐赠。

维持 EDG 用户所依赖的工程质量。

具备来自内部的 C++ 编译器前端知识。

C++ Alliance 是一家非营利组织，拥有经过验证的财政赞助基础设施、在职的 C++ 编译器工程师，并且深深扎根于 C++ 标准和 Boost 社区。它将成为 EDG 的非营利归属机构。

进一步了解 C++ Alliance

EDG 的运作方式将与其他开源项目一样：任何人都可以贡献，所有合并的内容都向所有人开放。开发沿着三条路径进行：用户社区的贡献、持续维护，以及由集体出资支持的功能开发。

EDG 用户提交的错误修复和新功能将以拉取请求的形式提交。审核人员最初将由经验丰富的 EDG 开发者担任，他们会评估这些更改。获得批准后，这些更改将合并到 EDG 代码库中。

由联盟的 EDG 开发者完成的错误修复和维护内容会立即发布。

为支持 EDG 社区，联盟将提供一种方式，让社区能够开发并资助规模较大的功能。这样，各组织可以通过资金支持大型功能的开发，而不必安排自己的开发者投入这些功能的开发。一项功能获得资助后，将同时向所有人发布。

一套代码库，所有人共享。无论更改通过哪条路径到达，都会在同一时间进入同一个公开代码仓库。没有人会获得提前访问权限。

财政赞助委员会（FSC）负责监督这三条路径上的整个流程。委员会由 John Spicer 担任主席，并将包括来自 EDG 用户社区的志愿者。

想对委员会成员构成发表意见？请了解如何参与。

这对你意味着什么

引擎、它所实现的标准，以及你联系的人员都保持不变。工作的资助方式和代码的存放位置则会改变。

financeStories.title: DoorDash的无人机战略始于地面
financeStories.originalTitle: DoorDash’s drone strategy started on the ground
financeStories.snippet: DoorDash unveiled the six-propeller aircraft that will be used in its new drone delivery business at its annual Dash Forward 2026 event.
financeStories.fullContent:
When DoorDash set out to build a drone delivery business, it started with the tricky logistics that happen on the ground before it looked up.

The autonomous drone came last, according to the company, which unveiled its new six-propeller aircraft at its annual Dash Forward 2026 event on Wednesday.

Before DoorDash worked on the aircraft, the company focused on ground infrastructure, including loading systems, how food would be handed off from a restaurant’s kitchen, and packaging.

DoorDash Labs, the R&D team that built its autonomous sidewalk delivery bot Dot, created the drone delivery service now called DoorDash Air. The same team also developed the underlying software, called the Autonomous Delivery Platform (ADP), to handle the coordination challenges in deliveries handled by humans, sidewalk delivery bots, and now drones.

The ADP software uses smart routing, incorporating factors like weather, flight range, and ground traffic to narrow down which orders actually make sense to send by air.

The company’s systems-first strategy for its DoorDash Air business aligns with its strengths. DoorDash isn’t a hardware company, but it is sitting on 13 years of user data from the merchant and customer sides of the business. (DoorDash has previously disclosed that more than 500,000 restaurants are on its delivery marketplace.)

The company says it sized the whole DoorDash Air system around its historical order data, including how much orders weigh and how far they typically travel.

“We didn’t start with a drone and ask what would fit,” Harrison Shih, who heads up DoorDash Air, said in a statement. “We started with what people order and how local businesses actually operate, then built the entire system from there.”

DoorDash announced plans in July to launch the drone delivery business after receiving a Part 135 air carrier certification from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration. The certification allows the company to legally operate a commercial drone delivery service in the United States.

The drone, which has six slow-spinning propellers mounted at the ends of its arms, is equipped with a winch to pick up, carry, and drop off packages.

DoorDash said it plans to kick off early pilot deliveries in Northern California with partners including Chipotle, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, and Momo N Curry.

DoorDash着手打造无人机配送业务时，首先从地面上那些复杂的物流环节入手——这些环节发生在抬头关注天空之前。

据该公司介绍，自主无人机是最后才开发的。DoorDash于周三在年度Dash Forward 2026活动上展示了这款全新的六旋翼飞行器。

在着手研发飞行器之前，DoorDash专注于地面基础设施，包括装载系统、餐食如何从餐厅厨房交接出去，以及包装方案。

DoorDash实验室（DoorDash Labs）是该公司的研发团队，曾开发自主人行道配送机器人Dot；如今，该团队打造了这项现在名为DoorDash Air的无人机配送服务。同一团队还开发了底层软件——自主配送平台（Autonomous Delivery Platform，简称ADP），用于处理由人工配送员、人行道配送机器人以及如今的无人机执行配送时所面临的协调难题。

ADP软件采用智能路径规划，将天气、飞行航程和地面交通等因素纳入考量，从而筛选出哪些订单真正适合通过空中配送。

DoorDash Air业务以系统为先的战略，与公司的优势相契合。DoorDash并不是一家硬件公司，但它拥有来自商家和消费者两端、积累了13年的用户数据。（DoorDash此前披露，其配送平台上已有超过50万家餐厅。）

该公司表示，他们根据历史订单数据对整个DoorDash Air系统进行了规划，包括订单重量以及订单通常需要配送多远。

“我们并不是先做出一架无人机，再去问它能装下什么，”DoorDash Air负责人哈里森·希（Harrison Shih）在一份声明中说。“我们从人们会订购什么，以及本地商家实际如何运营入手，然后以此为基础构建了整个系统。”

DoorDash于7月宣布了推出无人机配送业务的计划，此前该公司已获得美国联邦航空管理局颁发的第135部航空承运人认证。该认证允许公司在美国合法运营商业无人机配送服务。

这款无人机的机臂末端装有六个低速旋转的螺旋桨，并配备绞盘，用于拾取、运送和投放包裹。

DoorDash表示，计划与Chipotle、Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen以及Momo N Curry等合作伙伴一起，在北加州启动早期试点配送。

financeStories.title: 宝马为汽油版和电动车打造了同一款车型，电动车便宜4400美元
financeStories.originalTitle: BMW built the same car for gas and electric. The EV is $4,400 cheaper.
financeStories.snippet: The new BMW 3 Series shows just how quickly EVs have caught up to fossil fuel vehicles on pricing.
financeStories.fullContent:
For years, automotive analysts have been predicting that electric vehicles would become cheaper than their gas-powered equivalents. They figured it would happen sometime in the latter half of the 2020s. BloombergNEF, for example, expected it to happen in 2026.

They weren’t far off.

EV prices have dropped significantly in the last few years, but it has been hard to compare prices with fossil fuel vehicles because not every EV has a like-for-like gas-powered model.

BMW has given us one. The 2027 BMW 3 Series comes in both gas and electric versions, and the EV is $4,400 cheaper.

The gas-powered M350 xDrive will set you back $65,900, while the electric i3 50 xDrive will cost $61,500; neither price includes destination charges. Both are similarly powerful, similarly styled, and aimed at similar pocketbooks. The difference is the EV is 6.7% cheaper.

Pedants will point out there’s a significantly cheaper gas-powered 3 Series trim, though it has no electric equivalent yet. The 2027 BMW 330 is priced at $49,900, and its upgraded xDrive trim costs $51,900.

The two comparable vehicles are built on different platforms, with the EV i3 benefiting from BMW’s newest chassis and technology. The gas-powered 3 Series makes do with an overhauled version of an existing platform.

For most people, the biggest difference will be the charging or refueling experience, but even there they’re more similar than some might expect.

The range of the new gas 3 Series is likely similar to previous models, or about 450 miles per tank in all-wheel-drive guise. The electric i3 will travel 468 miles on a full charge, and BMW says the vehicle’s fast charging is speedy enough to replenish 208 miles of range in 10 minutes. The difference might be noticeable to extreme road warriors, but for most drivers, it’ll be academic.

The generally accepted wisdom is that EVs have cost more up front, even if they’ve delivered a lower total cost of ownership. But now EVs are gaining the upper hand on purchase price, too.

多年来，汽车分析师一直预测，电动汽车的价格将低于同级别的汽油动力车型。他们认为，这种情况将在2020年代后半段的某个时候发生。例如，彭博新能源财经曾预计这一转折点会出现在2026年。

他们的预测并没有偏离太远。

过去几年，电动汽车价格大幅下降，但由于并非每款电动车都有完全对应的汽油动力车型，因此很难将电动车价格与化石燃料汽车进行比较。

宝马为我们提供了这样一个可比案例。2027款宝马3系同时推出汽油版和电动版，而电动车便宜了4400美元。

汽油动力的M350 xDrive售价为65900美元，电动版i3 50 xDrive售价为61500美元；两者价格均不含目的地费用。两款车的动力和设计风格相近，面向的消费者群体也相似。区别在于，电动车便宜了6.7%。

吹毛求疵的人会指出，汽油版3系还有一款明显便宜得多的配置，只是目前还没有对应的电动车型。2027款宝马330售价为49900美元，升级后的xDrive版本售价为51900美元。

这两款可比车型基于不同平台打造，其中电动版i3受益于宝马最新的底盘和技术。汽油版3系则采用了现有平台的改进版本。

对大多数人来说，两者最大的区别将是充电和加油体验，但即便在这一点上，它们也比一些人预想的更加相似。

新款汽油版3系的续航里程可能与此前车型相近，配备全轮驱动时每箱油大约可行驶450英里。电动版i3充满电后可行驶468英里，宝马表示，该车的快速充电速度足够快，10分钟即可补充208英里的续航里程。对于极少数长途驾驶者来说，这一差异或许会比较明显，但对大多数驾驶者而言，它更多只是理论上的区别。

普遍接受的观点是，电动车前期购车成本更高，即使其总拥有成本更低。但现在，电动车在购车价格方面也开始占据优势。

financeStories.title: 要闻：AI 基础设施工程师、存储开发者和云服务提供商需要快速、安全地访问高容量文件和对象存储，以支持 AI 工作负载
financeStories.originalTitle: Expanding AI Storage Access with NVIDIA cuObject and the NVIDIA SCADA Server SDK
financeStories.source: NVIDIA Developer Blog (英伟达开发者官方英文)
